verses.text: “My soul is weary of my life. I will give free course to my complaint. I will speak in the bitterness of my soul.
lines: “My soul is weary of my life.
I will give free course to my complaint.
I will speak in the bitterness of my soul.

verses.text: I will tell God, ‘Do not condemn me. Show me why you contend with me.
lines: I will tell God, ‘Do not condemn me.
Show me why you contend with me.

verses.text: Is it good to you that you should oppress, that you should despise the work of your hands, and smile on the counsel of the wicked?
lines: Is it good to you that you should oppress,
that you should despise the work of your hands,
and smile on the counsel of the wicked?

verses.text: Do you have eyes of flesh? Or do you see as man sees?
lines: Do you have eyes of flesh?
Or do you see as man sees?

verses.text: Are your days as the days of mortals, or your years as man’s years,
lines: Are your days as the days of mortals,
or your years as man’s years,

verses.text: that you inquire after my iniquity, and search after my sin?
lines: that you inquire after my iniquity,
and search after my sin?

verses.text: Although you know that I am not wicked, there is no one who can deliver out of your hand.
lines: Although you know that I am not wicked,
there is no one who can deliver out of your hand.

verses.text: “ ‘Your hands have framed me and fashioned me altogether, yet you destroy me.
lines: “ ‘Your hands have framed me and fashioned me altogether,
yet you destroy me.

verses.text: Remember, I beg you, that you have fashioned me as clay. Will you bring me into dust again?
lines: Remember, I beg you, that you have fashioned me as clay.
Will you bring me into dust again?

verses.text: Haven’t you poured me out like milk, and curdled me like cheese?
lines: Haven’t you poured me out like milk,
and curdled me like cheese?

verses.text: You have clothed me with skin and flesh, and knit me together with bones and sinews.
lines: You have clothed me with skin and flesh,
and knit me together with bones and sinews.

verses.text: You have granted me life and loving kindness. Your visitation has preserved my spirit.
lines: You have granted me life and loving kindness.
Your visitation has preserved my spirit.

verses.text: Yet you hid these things in your heart. I know that this is with you:
lines: Yet you hid these things in your heart.
I know that this is with you:

verses.text: if I sin, then you mark me. You will not acquit me from my iniquity.
lines: if I sin, then you mark me.
You will not acquit me from my iniquity.

verses.text: If I am wicked, woe to me. If I am righteous, I still will not lift up my head, being filled with disgrace, and conscious of my affliction.
lines: If I am wicked, woe to me.
If I am righteous, I still will not lift up my head,
being filled with disgrace,
and conscious of my affliction.

verses.text: If my head is held high, you hunt me like a lion. Again you show yourself powerful to me.
lines: If my head is held high, you hunt me like a lion.
Again you show yourself powerful to me.

verses.text: You renew your witnesses against me, and increase your indignation on me. Changes and warfare are with me.
lines: You renew your witnesses against me,
and increase your indignation on me.
Changes and warfare are with me.

verses.text: “ ‘Why, then, have you brought me out of the womb? I wish I had given up the spirit, and no eye had seen me.
lines: “ ‘Why, then, have you brought me out of the womb?
I wish I had given up the spirit, and no eye had seen me.

verses.text: I should have been as though I had not been. I should have been carried from the womb to the grave.
lines: I should have been as though I had not been.
I should have been carried from the womb to the grave.

verses.text: Aren’t my days few? Stop! Leave me alone, that I may find a little comfort,
lines: Aren’t my days few?
Stop!
Leave me alone, that I may find a little comfort,

verses.text: before I go where I will not return from, to the land of darkness and of the shadow of death;
lines: before I go where I will not return from,
to the land of darkness and of the shadow of death;

verses.text: the land dark as midnight, of the shadow of death, without any order, where the light is as midnight.’ ”
lines: the land dark as midnight,
of the shadow of death,
without any order,
where the light is as midnight.’ ”
